landing.badge: One school. One deployment. One database.
landing.heroSub: Attendance, academics, fees, leave, homework and more — unified in a single, secure, role-aware ERP.
landing.marqueeLabel: Built for every corner of school operations
landing.f1p: Student, teacher and staff attendance in one engine — biometric, QR or manual.
landing.f2p: Invoicing, payments, scholarships and double-entry general ledger posting.
landing.f3p: Configurable grades, curricula, timetables and promotion rules.
landing.f4p: Every sensitive action is recorded append-only. Updates and deletes are refused at the database.
